answer: Every call to the engine is authenticated and carries where it comes from. Where a call comes from is taken from the way it arrived, never from what the call says about itself. A call that is not authenticated is refused before any handler runs. A call from inside a computer is scoped to that computer and can grant it nothing more. How the app and the command line prove who they are is to find out, on a Mac and on a remote host.
